dimension_tables.context: Cabinet height (A) and depth (B), referenced by letter callouts A and B on the single/double cabinet views

notes: Unless otherwise specified, all dimensions are in millimeters (title block general note).

Letter callouts A (cabinet height) and B (cabinet depth) on the single and double cabinet views are symbolic and are defined per product code in the product variants table, not by a single fixed numeric value on this sheet.
Drawing shows single-cabinet and double-cabinet front views, each with an open-frame (rear) view and a door view; doors include a cam lock, ventilated bottom panels, and castors.
warnings: The '75' dimension near the top of the single cabinet front view could not be confirmed with certainty as to exactly what feature (frame lip vs. mounting rail offset) it measures.
This drawing covers a family of rack cabinet models (DE12000-DE12006 and a customizable variant); no single scale value is printed in the title block.
